title: Agricultural Administration Building (West Lafayette, Ind.)
record_date_scope: Historical information for the building's 1908 opening; the record says the building underwent multiple later renovations and name changes.

at_opening: The Agricultural Experiment Station Building was two stories high with a basement.
The exterior used brick with stone trimmings and a tile roof.
The building used reinforced concrete floors and iron and slate stairs.
later_history: The building underwent multiple renovations and name changes.
It was renamed Agricultural Administration Building in 1969.

scope_limit: These historical facts establish the 1908 design, not the present roof, current floor count, current floor spacing, or current height.
